description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for retrieving available financial indices data from the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API. It includes data classes for query parameters and data, and a fetcher class that implements methods to transform queries, fetch data asynchronously from the API, and transform raw data into structured models.

classes.name: FMPAvailableIndicesQueryParams
classes.description: A subclass of AvailableIndicesQueryParams specific to FMP, representing query parameters for fetching available indices from FMP.

classes.name: FMPAvailableIndicesData
classes.description: A subclass of AvailableIndicesData for representing the retrieved indices data from FMP.

classes.name: FMPAvailableIndicesFetcher
classes.description: A fetcher class implementing methods to construct queries, asynchronously fetch data from the FMP API, and transform raw data into structured data models.

methods.name: FMPAvailableIndicesQueryParams transform_query(params: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into an instance of FMPAvailableIndicesQueryParams.

methods.name: list[dict] aextract_data( query: FMPAvailableIndicesQueryParams, credentials: Optional[dict[str, str]], **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw indices data from the FMP API endpoint using the provided credentials.

methods.name: list[FMPAvailableIndicesData] transform_data( query: FMPAvailableIndicesQueryParams, data: list[dict], **kwargs: Any )
methods.description: Transforms raw data dictionaries into instances of FMPAvailableIndicesData.

ctags.name: aextract_data
ctags.signature: ( query: FMPAvailableIndicesQueryParams, credentials: Optional[dict[str, str]], **kwargs: Any, )
